dialogue_texts: A final act under the night sky?
I'm now laughing at you, pathetic queen of boundaries.
How delightfully cliché. Go ahead and amuse me.
You defeated my twin sister without even guessing the truth!
Oh, my dear, it's quite bold of you to project your own desperation onto me.
Now that I'm mad because you freed my princess...
Both you and Fusana will be cursed to serve the Order and me!
The truth is merely a boundary between what is known and what is hidden. I simply chose not to look.
I will give you a special reward for defeating my twin sister, and you will love it.
You forget who controls the boundaries of all restrictions in this world.
My dear, sweet, beautiful sister will be avenged!
